in_hebrew.name: עודלינדה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Odelinda is derived from the Hebrew word 'אדול' (adul), which means 'refuge', and the feminine suffix '-ה' (heh), which denotes feminine gender. Therefore, the name Odelinda in Hebrew means 'God is my refuge'.

in_greek.name: Οδελινδη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Odelinda is derived from the Greek words 'οδος' (hodos), which means 'way', and 'ελεος' (eleos), which means 'mercy'. Therefore, the name Odelinda in Greek means 'Just as God shows mercy'.

in_latin.name: Odelinda
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Odelinda is derived from the Latin words 'ode' (weaker) and 'linde' (to God). Therefore, the name Odelinda in Latin means 'Weaker to God'.
